tools.name: tracker_search_issues
tools.title: Search issues
tools.description: Search issues in the team tracker by text, status, or assignee. Use this when the user names a topic or person but not an issue key. Returns up to 25 issues with key, title, status, and assignee; narrow the query when results are truncated.

query.description: Words to match in titles and bodies.

tools.name: tracker_get_issue
tools.title: Get issue details
tools.description: Get one issue from the team tracker by key, with its description, status, labels, and the last 10 comments. Use tracker_search_issues first when you do not know the key.

issue_key.description: Issue key such as ENG-142. Get it from tracker_search_issues.

tools.name: tracker_create_issue
tools.title: Create issue
tools.description: Create an issue in the team tracker with a title, body, and optional labels. The gateway asks for approval before it runs. Returns the new issue key; do not retry on timeout, search first to avoid duplicates.

labels.description: Label names that already exist in the tracker.

tools.name: tracker_close_issue
tools.title: Close issue
tools.description: Close an open issue in the team tracker and add an optional closing comment. The gateway asks for approval. Closing an issue that is already closed returns the issue unchanged.

issue_key.description: Issue key such as ENG-142. Get it from tracker_search_issues.

comment.description: Optional comment that explains why the issue is closed.

tools.name: tracker_list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List every label in the team tracker with its color and the number of open issues that use it.
